meta.title: Gestioo – Management software for multisport clubs (Switzerland & France)
meta.description: Members, registrations, schedules, Swiss QR-bill, double-entry accounting and an AI assistant: one web tool to run your club without spreadsheets.

hero.eyebrow: For multisport clubs and associations – Switzerland & France
hero.title: Gestioo: run your club
hero.lead: Gestioo brings together members, registrations by season and team, the training schedule, membership invoicing with the Swiss QR-bill, double-entry accounting and communication with families – with a built-in AI assistant.

profiles.title: A solution for every role in the club
profiles.intro: Whether you volunteer on the committee, coach a team or are a parent, everyone quickly finds what they need.

items.before: spreadsheets, manual reminders, bank reconciliation by hand, a painful year-end close.
items.after: QR-bills generated and sent in bulk, reminders, camt bank statement import and reconciliation, automatic accounting entries, guided year-end close with balance sheet and income statement as PDF, tailor-made financial reports exported to Excel.

items.before: paper or email registrations, scattered team lists, tournament and trip sign-ups handled by chat, places freed by a withdrawal to reassign by hand, cancellation refunds worked out case by case.
items.after: online registration by families, one-click approval, up-to-date teams and rosters, event calendar with online sign-up, a waiting list that automatically reassigns freed places and cancellation terms applied without manual calculation, targeted bulk emails, custom lists and statistics exportable to CSV or Excel.

items.before: paper attendance sheets, a schedule shared over chat.
items.after: attendance taken on a smartphone, even without a network, a schedule by team and by hall, expense claims online.

items.before: no idea where their children's registration or payment stands.
items.after: the “My family” area: step-by-step registration, payment in 1 to 4 instalments, invoices, upcoming sessions, upcoming events with one-click sign-up (or waiting list when full), cancellation terms displayed and refund amount known before cancelling, and club announcements.
a dashboard (active members, fees collected, valid licences, balance to collect, pending tasks, upcoming events) and custom reports that can be saved and exported to Excel.

items.title: Designed and made in Switzerland
items.text: Swiss QR-bill, camt bank statements, AVS number, Swiss double-entry accounting and an interface in French, German and English.

items.title: Accounting built in, not bolted on
items.text: Every invoice, payment, refund, expense claim or supplier invoice automatically feeds the general ledger.

items.title: Families at the centre
items.text: One account = one family, several members, payment in instalments.

items.title: Works offline
items.text: Attendance taking at the pitch side keeps working without a network and syncs when the connection returns.

items.title: Voice AI assistant
items.text: Ask a question or create a registration by speaking, with confirmation before any action.

items.title: Permissions by role
items.text: Everyone (administrator, committee, staff, member) only sees what concerns them.

items.title: Installable on your phone
items.text: No app store needed, and always up to date.

items.title: In your club's colours
items.text: Your association's logo, main colour and login image.

items.title: Custom reports, no spreadsheet
items.text: The committee builds its own lists and statistics (columns, filters, totals), exports them to Excel or PDF and saves them as reusable templates.

items.title: Sponsors put in the spotlight
items.text: Partner announcements visible to families and an audience report with figures (views, clicks) to hand to the sponsor.

items.title: Free or paid events, effortlessly
items.text: Families sign their children up online; for a paid event, the QR invoice is issued and booked automatically.

items.title: Events open to outsiders
items.text: A shareable sign-up link lets people outside the club (tournaments, camps, open days) register and receive their QR invoice, kept separate from club members.

items.title: Cancellations and refunds without a spreadsheet
items.text: Cancellation terms chosen per event (tiers by date, administration fee), fixed at sign-up; on cancellation, the invoice is cancelled or a credit note is issued automatically and any overpayment is ready to refund, in the books and for the family alike. The waiting list reassigns the freed place with no intervention.

items.title: One simple price, all included
items.text: CHF 800 per year for all modules and all updates, with no hidden costs.

items.title: Built by people from the field
items.text: A team with 20 years of experience of sports associations' needs (notably basketball and boxing), and software developed by a computer engineer.

modules.title: Everything you need to run your club

groups.title: Members and families
items: Complete member record, change history and internal comments
Active / inactive status, filters and search
“My family” area: step-by-step registration, required actions, upcoming sessions over 7 days, upcoming events, announcements and direct editing of a member's record

groups.title: Seasons, teams and registrations
items: Seasons, teams (colour, roster, upcoming events and matches) and configurable roles
Registrations validated by the committee, discounts and payment in instalments
Re-registration in the same team after a cancellation; the cancelled registration and invoice stay in the history
Automatic emails when a registration is approved or cancelled

groups.title: Schedule and attendance
items: Halls, recurring time slots per team and holiday periods
Week and day schedule views in team colours
Attendance on a smartphone, even offline, with automatic sync

groups.title: Federation licences
items: Federations and licences per member
Licence paid by the club, invoiced to the member or paid directly by the member
Tracking of payments to the federation with an accounting entry

groups.title: Membership fees and invoicing
items: PDF invoices with Swiss QR-bill, sent by email with a sending history
Payment in 2, 3 or 4 instalments, single or bulk reminders
Payments, write-offs, overpayments refunded or applied to another invoice, numbered credit notes issued on a refunded cancellation

groups.title: Swiss double-entry accounting
items: Configurable chart of accounts, manual and automatic entries
Live balance sheet and income statement, PDF export
Guided year-end close and bank reconciliation by camt import

groups.title: Expense claims and suppliers
items: Expense claims with receipts and an approval workflow
Suppliers, contacts and supplier invoices with attachments
Automatic accounting entries

groups.title: Communication
items: Schedulable announcements (publication period), shown in the family area, the back office or both
Partner (sponsor) announcements with view and click statistics, day by day
Targeted bulk emails (season, team, age, role, event participants…) with history
Customisable email templates

groups.title: Events
items: Club event calendar (tournaments, galas, outings, meetings) with description, photos, date and venue
Team events, with the whole team summoned in one click
Free or paid online sign-ups: the QR invoice is issued and booked automatically
External participants via a public sign-up link, with conversion into club members
Waiting list for full events: the first person waiting is registered automatically as soon as a place frees up, invoiced if the event is paid and notified by email
Reusable cancellation terms (tiers by date, administration fee), fixed at sign-up; refund shown before confirming, credit note issued automatically, justified manual adjustment possible
Cancellation of a whole event by the club: registrations fully refunded and the reason sent to each family
Participant list with payment status, ordered waiting list and refunds granted

groups.title: Dashboard and reports
items: Active members, fees collected, valid licences, balance to collect, tasks to handle, upcoming events
Report builder on 12 data sources, as a list or grouped with totals
CSV, Excel and PDF export; private templates or templates shared with the committee

groups.title: Settings and access
items: Club name, logo, main colour and login image

Protected accounts: verified email, strong passwords, anti-bot protection

items.title: Access by role
items.text: Each user only sees and edits what their role allows; families only access their own data.

items.title: Protected accounts
items.text: Email verification, strong passwords, anti-bot protection (Cloudflare Turnstile) and secure sessions.

items.title: Tamper-proof accounting
items.text: A validated entry is locked; a correction goes through a traceable reversal; a closed financial year can no longer be modified.

items.title: Traceability
items.text: Change history of member records, history of emails and reminders sent per invoice.

items.title: AI under control
items.text: The assistant never creates anything without the user's explicit confirmation; European AI (Mistral AI).

items.title: Software quality
items.text: Every server feature is covered by automated tests.

items.title: Events: waiting list, cancellation terms and credit notes
items.text: When an event is full, families join a waiting list and the first person is registered automatically as soon as a place frees up. The club sets its cancellation terms; the refund is shown before cancelling, and the invoice is cancelled or a credit note is issued automatically, with the matching accounting entries. The club can also cancel a whole event, with each registration fully refunded.

items.title: Registrations: re-register after a cancellation
items.text: A member whose registration was cancelled (for example because of a mistake in the number of payments) can be registered again in the same team. The cancelled registration and invoice remain available in the history.

items.title: Events: free or paid sign-ups, including for outsiders
items.text: The club keeps its event calendar, summons a team in one click and opens sign-ups to families – and, through a public link, to outside participants. For a paid event, the QR invoice is issued and booked automatically.

items.title: Scheduled announcements and partner announcements with statistics
items.text: Announcements have a publication period and can be shown in the family area, the back office or both. Partner announcements come with a report of views and clicks to show sponsors.

items.title: Family area: edit a member's record directly
items.text: From the family list, contact details, address, emergency contact, health data and default payment can be edited without leaving the page.

items.title: Custom reports: CSV, Excel and PDF exports
items.text: The committee and administrators build lists and statistics over 9 data sources, export them as CSV, Excel or PDF, and save private or shared templates that can be exported in one click.
